item.title: Re: Character?
item.content:encoded:
What did the image look like exactly?

I remember it being an image of a man in the distance, walking along a giant sand dune.

Can't remember what the explanation of the image was. I think it was something about it being a photo of SCP-920 observed wandering in the Sahara, or some other desert.

item.title: Character?
item.content:encoded:
Asian. Constantly getting lost in impossible ways. Traversing across deserts, oceans, and pretty much everywhere…And being tough enough to survive these conditions…Yeah, that sounds a hell of a lot like one Ryoga Hibiki from an anime called Ranma1/2. Just without a certain water-based curse of his.

Now that the thought has entered my mind, I can't help but find the image of Dr. Wondertainment themselves dabbling into a little bit of copyright infringement absolutely hilarious. Unless they're located far enough into the future that Ranma1/2 becomes part of the public domain.

What did the image look like exactly?

item.title: Image Usage
item.content:encoded:
SCP-920's image was removed because of it's owner's copyright policy (iStock). It may be added once again if/when proper attribution or proper use under CC guidelines is confirmed. Please contact me or another member of the Image Team if you have questions.

On the article: I really liked the picture, it really set the tone. Hopefully Salman can find another.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Attempts at transporting SCP-920 to any destination will result in transporters becoming lost.

Attempts at directing SCP-920 will result in SCP-920 becoming lost.

Following SCP-920 will result in SCP-920 and the follower becoming lost

Conversing with SCP-920 is not recommended, as typically subjects will follow SCP-920 and become lost.

Did I mention "lost'?

The repeated use of the word "lost" strikes me as decidedly non-clinical and breaks immersion. Downvoted.
